issues.title: Course lesson videos not playing for students
issues.problem_statement: Some of the customer's students say the course lesson videos keep loading and never play, mostly on their phones; the customer said this was the third time raising it.

items.description: Support opened one affected lesson link on desktop Chrome, Safari and a phone, found the video played each time, and could not reproduce the problem from support's side; the customer said students are still facing it.
evidence: It plays on Safari and on my phone too. So I cannot reproduce the problem from my side.
But my students are really facing it.

items.description: Support will raise the issue with the technical team and get back to the customer; support did not give a timeline.
evidence: I'll raise this with our technical team and get back to you.

items.description: Customer will ask one affected student to record a short screen recording of the video loading and send it to support along with the lesson link.
evidence: Okay, I'll ask one of the students to record it and send it to you.

skip_recommendation.explanation: Complete support call with clear next steps; the issue remains unresolved.
